Now we're turning the way we run our business with AI into a product. We're building an AI initiative — Seller Pilots — and we're hiring an AI Engineer at CE Showroom to design and build the autonomous AI advisor at the heart of it. To be clear: you'd be employed by CE Showroom; Seller Pilots is the project you'd help build.

This is a full\-time, on\-site role in the Roseville / greater Sacramento area — we work together, in person, so you'll need to be local or willing to commute.

\- Connects to the data: our database, Amazon SP\-API, MS SQL, advertising APIs, and other marketplace APIs (Amazon, Walmart, and more) to pull in everything about a seller's account, ads, pricing, and inventory.

\- Gathers the facts and asks the right questions: it talks to the user, asks clarifying questions before acting, and combines that with the data.

\- Lets the user stay in control: they can approve, ask for more detail, or pick an option.

\- Then executes: once the decision is made, the system makes it happen across the marketplace accounts.

\- A plus, not a must: a strong software\-development background. AI tools handle much of the coding; what matters most is deep AI fluency.
